pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit sequential entries within 5 minutes of a previous stop-out; no scaling into high-velocity wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume delta and order-book imbalance must confirm directional momentum before limit or market orders are triggered.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation as soon as unrealized profit hits +$10.00 to prevent evaporation of gains.
